data.name: Staybridge Suites Chihuahua by IHG
data.address: Paseos Vista del Sol 6803, Fracc. Comercial, Vista del Sol, 31206 Chihuahua, Chih., Mexico
data.description:
This relaxed hotel is 8 km from the 18th-century Catedral Metropolitana de Chihuahua and 24 km from Aeropuerto Internacional General Roberto Fierro Villalobos.
The warm, contemporary studios and 1- to 2-bedroom suites feature Wi-Fi access, satellite TV and DVD players, as well as kitchens and living areas. Room service is available.
There's also a lounge offering drinks and snacks. Other amenities include a heated outdoor pool, a hot tub and a gym, plus a BBQ area, a business center and a screening room. Pets are welcome for a fee.
